description: This file defines the ProducerEventCountingGrain class, an Orleans grain implementation responsible for producing stream events, tracking the count of items produced, and managing stream interactions.

classes.name: ProducerEventCountingGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain class that acts as a producer in a streaming scenario, maintaining and sending stream events, and managing stream lifecycle.

methods.name: ProducerEventCountingGrain(ILoggerFactory loggerFactory)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the grain with a logger.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation, resets production count, and logs activation.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain deactivation, resets production count, and logs deactivation.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Configures the grain to become a producer for a specific stream identified by streamId, using a specified provider.

methods.name: GetNumberProduced
methods.description: Returns the number of items produced so far.

methods.name: SendEvent
methods.description: Sends an event (incremented count) to the stream and updates internal counter.
